verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a single public API that covers all payment methods. The docs list tenant and environment endpoints, JWS request signing, JSON error responses, an interactive API Reference that sends requests, a sandbox, and specific endpoints such as /ws/capture. Together these let an AI-native user drive payments, payouts and refunds programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: A single unified API handles all payment methods, countries, and operating models.
Select the tenant by using the matching endpoint for the tenant and environment. Request paths and resources are the same across tenants
Direct API integration that gives you full control over the checkout experience and payment logic
sends the request directly from the API Reference.
Card payments with `auto_capture: false` require a separate capture request to `/ws/capture`.
